0.9·6^(8−j), each logit equals the sum over j from d to 8 of (R/τ_j − 1). Digit 9 gets weight 0 and bias 0, and `=` gets a bias of −1e9.
- **Precision:** everything runs in float64.
- **Parameter count:** 11 (token embedding) + 16 (position embedding) + 4 (attention) + 11 (head weights) + 11 (head biases) = 53.
